flavour_weld.firewall: No phase-resolved intertwiner between the Pass11921 theta-function Higgs basis and the Pass11664 transverse basis is constructed here. Representation compatibility is not a derived physical coupling.
flavour_weld.representation_target: The exact Witting tangent is already the G25/H27 qutrit triplet of Pass11664. Pass11921 independently produces a three-dimensional up-Higgs flavour qutrit. Therefore the minimal symmetry-breaking spurion needed to move the Witting vacuum has exactly the representation type required by the flavour sector.

allowed_alternatives: an explicit G32-breaking spurion in the transverse G25 triplet
a bifurcation after an invariant correction changes a tangent Hessian sign
a cross-sector coupling whose background breaks the Witting stabilizer
pass11891_correction.reason: The invariant has zero projective tangent differential at every Witting ray. It can lift the common phase or change tangent Hessian/stability, but cannot supply a linear displacement force.
pass11891_correction.stands: Im(Omega)~(3/pi)log(1/delta) and the theta hierarchy epsilon is linear in an externally supplied projective displacement delta.
pass11891_correction.withdraw: A G32-invariant degree-12 scalar operator by itself generically produces delta~(v/Lambda)^8.

physics_consequence: A realistic hierarchy cannot be attributed to a fully G32-symmetric higher-dimensional correction if it relies on moving off the radiative Witting ray. The displacement source must break the Witting-ray little group (or arise after a stability bifurcation).
theorem: Let r be a Witting ray and T_r its three-complex-dimensional projective Cartan tangent. The pointwise stabilizer contains the exact G25 parabolic of order 648. Its action on T_r and on T_r^* has no trivial submodule. Hence for every differentiable G32-invariant scalar V, dV_r restricted to T_r is zero. In particular any scalar potential made only from the G32 invariant generators of degrees 12,18,24,30 keeps every Witting ray an exact stationary ray.
